personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center designed for instant readability and fast action during live play.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing around live scores for readability. Tight utility spacing in admin tables and settings.

do's: Use solid colors or tinted surfaces for performance on active scoreboards.
dont's: Avoid heavy glass blur over moving numbers or active scoring screens to ensure immediate tactile response.

screens.name: Public Live Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides spectators with a fast, auto-refreshing view of live matches, schedule, and leaderboard.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored activity indicator with a 'Loading Match Data...' prompt.
states.empty: No active matches. Show an abstract pickleball net illustration with 'Tournament resumes soon'.
states.error: Failed to sync. Retry button prominently displayed.

screens.layout: Sticky top tabs (Live | Upcoming | Completed | Leaderboard). Matches presented as edge-to-edge cards with solid dividers. Live matches feature a pulsing 'Live' indicator. Team names large (Bebas Neue), score bold and high-contrast. Use a 2-column grid for tablet, single column full width for mobile.

screens.name: Referee Match Scoring (HERO)
screens.purpose: A massive, one-handed touch target interface designed to increment live scores instantly without looking.

states.empty: Match not started. Large 'Start Match' CTA in center.
states.error: Connection lost banner at the top, scoring capabilities remain available offline to sync later.

screens.layout: Screen split horizontally into two massive tap targets taking up 80% of the screen. Top block (Team A), Bottom block (Team B). Each block contains the Team Name, enormous 96pt+ Score centered, and serves as a full-bleed `Pressable` for +1 point. A distinct 'Undo' icon button sits safely in the bottom safe area alongside the 'Finish Match' swipe-to-confirm slider. Colors of blocks slightly differ to indicate court side.

screens.name: Match Card Component
screens.purpose: A scan-friendly summary of a match's current state.

states.loading: Skeleton rectangles for team names and scores.

screens.layout: Card uses `surfaceSecondary`. Left side: Team A and Team B stacked vertically. Right side: Corresponding scores. Top right: Badge (Live in red, Upcoming in subtle gray, Completed in brand green). High contrast text, minimal padding to keep it tight.

screens.name: Admin Management & Login
screens.purpose: A strict utility interface for organizing the tournament and managing access.

states.empty: No teams created. Large 'Add First Team' button.
states.error: Inline text error under failed input.

screens.layout: Login uses a clean single-column form with large touch targets. Referee PIN is a 4-box input. Admin CRUD screens use stacked rows (list view) with a floating action button (FAB) for adding new entries. Forms have labels above inputs and a sticky 'Save' button at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. Use Volt Green (#D4FF00) as the primary brand color for highlights and active states.
Implement the Referee Match Scoring screen with massive 96pt fonts for the score using the `Bebas Neue` font. Divide the screen horizontally into two massive interactive blocks.
Do NOT use any blue, purple, indigo, or navy colors anywhere in the UI. Ensure absolute adherence to the color rules.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all screens with a filled weight for active states and regular weight for inactive states.
Ensure dark mode and light mode are handled correctly with high contrast. The utility layout should prioritize function and readability above all else.
Add a vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over any background imagery used on the dashboard or splash screen.
Avoid glassmorphism to keep the UI snappy and high-performance, fitting the utility sports app aesthetic.
